name: Elicitation
description: Elicitation is the technique of extracting information from a target through natural conversation without them realizing they are being interrogated. Unlike direct questioning, elicitation uses open-ended prompts, flattery, apparent ignorance, and deliberate incorrect statements — which people instinctively correct — to draw out sensitive information. In physical red teaming, elicitation is used to identify badge access levels, security procedures, shift schedules, vendor relationships, and system configurations.

blue.det: No direct observable indicators — conversation appears natural; post-incident review of what information was shared; employee reports feeling "pumped for information" after interaction.
blue.cm: Security awareness training focused on information-sharing in conversation; need-to-know culture; employees briefed on elicitation techniques; debrief employees after unusual visitor interactions.

refs.t: Social Engineering: The Science of Human Hacking
